title: Hatsune Miku — Because You Burn So Bright〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They sound more motivated than usual.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (The last time we sang together, they had a little trouble staying focused.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But today, they sound really solid.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's probably because they have a better idea of what they need to do next since An's dad is going to start watching them practice.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I think they can do better right now.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They should be able to project their voices and feelings even more!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright...
Why don't we take a break here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We still can't keep up with you, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's right. You have such a delicate style, but we find ourselves overwhelmed by your volume and presence.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can't really ask for a better person to practice with.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we have to eventually figure out a way to become better than Miku, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's what I like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I really like the expression Kohane's making now. I think she's really embracing her identity as a singer...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Still, this is a bit frustrating.
The four of us are singing as a team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Miku's just that good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Honestly, I'm having trouble seeing you sulking in defeat or anything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? I actually felt that way pretty recently.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, you did?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: There's so much I wanted to tell you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were supposed to meet Kohane...! And Akito and Toya...! You were supposed to tell me I'd found the best team ever...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you were supposed to see the moment we did it...! When we surpassed RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You were supposed to do all of that...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you're gone...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Tears of sorrow*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you all battled against Taiga, and when you heard the truth about RAD WEEKEND and Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All we could do was watch...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was beyond frustrating.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You were right in front of us.
All we had to do was say something, but we couldn't.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But we also knew that nothing we did would actually help.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, our hope is that you'll all help clear this feeling from our minds someday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, of course! You can count on us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, I think we're all pretty sick of feeling that way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. So let's find a way to vindicate ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to it.
